stance: Klyvaron Lite/Pro/Max are processing/resource/context profiles of one shared model-independent engine. Separate trained Pro/Max models are not part of this release. Third-party provider models are never represented as first-party Klyvaron.

models.label: Klyvaron Lite
models.architecture: Model-independent deterministic Klyvaron processor (no separate trained model per tier)
models.tokenizer: Deterministic text tokenizer in services/core/src/knowledge/text.mjs; no model tokenizer is loaded
models.tierSemantics: processing/resource/context/orchestration profile of one shared engine, not a distinct model

architectureAndTokenizer.reason: The active processor is model-independent; no trained architecture/tokenizer artifact is installed to inspect.

weightsPresent.reason: No weight payload is tracked or installed in this checkout.

sha256Verified.reason: Expected digests exist only in archived metadata; there are no bytes to hash and no trusted download source.

realInference.reason: No loaded model; provider inference requires an authorized credential.

outputLatencyResourceErrorHandling.reason: Requires a loaded model and a runtime run.

chatSelection.evidence: docs/release/evidence/e2e-qualification.json → chat.model_selection_no_substitution (isolated test service); explicit provider model selection and refusal of unlisted models

tierModelSeparation.evidence: services/core/test/online.test.mjs and docs/33-model-independent-klyvaron.md; /api/klyvaron/{lite,pro,max} and tier→model mappings are refused with 410

unavailableReporting.evidence: docs/release/evidence/e2e-qualification.json → chat.model_selection_no_substitution returns coded 409 model_unavailable; unconfigured image/video providers return 503 provider_not_configured

multimodal.justification: No first-party image/audio/video weights exist in this release; native multimodal model requests are explicitly refused with 410 model_independent_architecture.

models.unblock: Provide an authorized, licensed weight payload for the archived Klyvaron Lite architecture (expected filenames and digests listed under archivedCards). Publish a trusted download source with a SHA-256 manifest, then independently verify the downloaded bytes. Provide compatible hardware/runtime (CPU memory for the fp32/int8 NumPy artifacts) and an installation procedure that does not place weights in Git. Record real load, inference, latency, resource and error-handling logs for the exact verified bytes; do not classify metadata as an operational model.
